concerns.text: Task T008 claims to run the full factorial sweep (10 × 2 × 3 × 500 = 30 000 rows) but its verification uses a `--dry-run` flag that only simulates the CSV structure without actually executing the agent on the full 500‑task set. This weakens FR‑003, which requires a *real* end‑to‑end run over the entire synthetic dataset, and thus violates constraint preservation.
